# Vivid Money

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: European business-bank marketing: a #222 promo bar, purple wordmark, pill Login and Get started, 52px Satoshi headlines, soft-purple featured plan cards, and a signed-out login that uses a second purple.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (public marketing and the business login chrome; no email, phone, card or KYC was entered). Themes: light.

Tokens and component notes for Vivid Money, the European business and personal bank at [vivid.money](https://vivid.money/). Captured 2026-11-19. Desktop screenshots are 1440×900. Phone screenshots are 390×844. Public marketing pages and the signed-out login chrome only. No account was created. No email, phone number, card, or KYC value was typed. No form was submitted.

The marketing site is a tokenised CSS build. Custom properties on `:root` name colour (`--main-c*`, `--color-*`), type, spacing, radii, shadows and layout. `html` carried `data-theme="light"`. The business login at `business.vivid.money/en/login` paints a different purple and uses Inter for body text. Satoshi is the marketing face and the login heading face.

## Typography

9 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Satoshi.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Satoshi is the marketing family, declared as `--font-family` and loaded at weights 400, 500 and 600. The login heading also uses Satoshi, at weight 700. The login body uses Inter. The files are not in this package. The tokens fall back to the system sans.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The hero headline is 52px on the page. The token `--font-size-h1` is 40px. Both are recorded. The 52px figure is the computed headline, not the custom property.

The login Continue button is `#6a26d9`. The marketing Get started button is `#7d33f6`. They are different purples. Do not collapse them.

Screenshots are 256-colour PNGs. Read colours from `tokens.json`, not from the images.

The signup form on the marketing page shows a country and a phone prefix that the site filled in. Nothing was typed into it. That chrome is a wall, not a completed signup.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Do paint Get started as a purple pill.** The fill is `#7d33f6`, the radius is `100px`, the label is white at 16px weight 500. [screenshots/home-light-desktop.png](screenshots/home-light-desktop.png)
- **Do keep Login as an outline pill.** The border is `#7d33f6` and the label matches it. [screenshots/home-light-desktop.png](screenshots/home-light-desktop.png)
- **Do set the headline in Satoshi at 52px, weight 500, with tight tracking.** [screenshots/home-light-desktop.png](screenshots/home-light-desktop.png)
- **Do paint the promo bar `#222`.** The seat button on it is a white pill. [screenshots/home-light-desktop.png](screenshots/home-light-desktop.png)
- **Do use the soft purple for the featured plan.** The Pro card is `#f4edff` with a 24px radius. [screenshots/pricing-light-desktop.png](screenshots/pricing-light-desktop.png)
- **Don't invent a dark theme.** The public pages stayed on light.
- **Don't treat the login purple as the marketing purple.** Continue on the login page is `#6a26d9`.
- **Don't type into the signup form.** It asks for a company name and a phone number. That flow was not entered. [screenshots/signup-wall-light-desktop.png](screenshots/signup-wall-light-desktop.png)
- **Don't ship the Satoshi files.** They are licensed to the product.
- **Don't follow Open a business account past the wall.**
